page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25%, reflecting a lower clock speed. However, multi-core performance, including Geekbench multi-core and Passmark CPU scores, reaches average levels. Memory bandwidth tests for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks also demonstrate average performance, alongside steady Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its modest single-threaded performance compared to its robust memory capacity. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1ne.6xlarge offers a dense memory profile relative to its compute resources, making it a viable choice for memory-intensive workloads that do not require extreme single-core processing speeds. It is well-suited for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, medium-scale web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications requiring substantial memory overhead.
